resources.string: Done: Mumla Funk is exempt from battery optimization, the phone may sleep while nobody talks.
Tap and allow. Otherwise the phone is kept awake while connected and only the radio saves energy.

While nobody talks, Mumla Funk can let your phone sleep. Transmissions still wake it up right away. For this, Android has to exempt Mumla Funk from battery optimization. Please allow it in the next window.

Opens the Mumla Funk walkie-talkie popup when you hold the volume-down key for 2 seconds. A short press keeps changing the volume as usual. The service only looks at the volume-down key; it does not read screen content.

Mumla Funk uses the Android accessibility service for one thing only: when you hold the volume-down key for 2 seconds, the walkie-talkie popup opens, even when the app is not open.

For this, Android passes the presses of the hardware keys to the service. Mumla Funk only evaluates the volume-down key. It does not read screen content or what you type, and it does not store, send or share any data.

Next, the Android settings open. Switch on “Mumla Funk volume key” there. You can switch it off there at any time.
